notes.title: Build Version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
Build version 1.2.2

In this new version, the Zombies have been modified. The code has been adjusted and now the Zombies suffer more damage and die faster.

Bernard now appears in more situations explaining what should be done, both in Last Colony and in the Chemical Factory.

The game is more optimized, suffering less crashes.

The lighting and some animations have been improved.

In April, new scenarios will be released.

We thank all Strangeland - The Last Colony players for their partnership and help in the development of the game.

Thank you.

Mário Conti
ENDLESS GameDev
